title: HUSKY B / CTDHP Prior Authorization — Scaling & Root Planing (D4341)
description: DTR questionnaire for the HUSKY B (CTDHP) prior-authorization pathway for periodontal scaling and root planing (D4341). PA intake is handled by the BeneCare ASO; the DTR/PAS determination and claims adjudication are performed by Gainwell (DSS fiscal agent, CMAP), with traffic routed through Connie. Medical-necessity justification is particularly relevant for a pediatric patient, where periodontitis is unusual.

item.text: Periodontal risk assessment / clinical findings supporting scaling and root planing (probing depths, attachment loss, radiographic bone loss)
